description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for YouTube recommendations, including generating search keywords via AI and fetching top YouTube videos based on a search string.

methods.name: toVideoSummary
methods.description: Normalizes a YouTube search result item to an object containing id, title, and thumbnail.

methods.name: POST /recommendations/youtube-keyword
methods.description: Generates a YouTube search keyword using AI, with fallback to course and lesson titles if AI fails.

methods.name: GET /recommendations/youtube
methods.description: Fetches top 3 YouTube videos matching a search string.
